title: Worldwide seasonal dry-matter feed diagnostics
interpretation: Dry-matter resource and storage scenarios, not nutritionally adequate herds, animal products, human population, actual livelihoods or political control.
annual_supply: Published Miami NPP; reuse existing Harvest aboveground/edible/usable shares and exclude its assigned cropped area. Coefficients remain model assumptions, not new empirical calibration.
seasonality: Uncalibrated temperature-rainfall proxy normalized to conserve annual DM. Positive annual supply without active seasonal weights is unresolved; no uniform-growth fallback.
storage: Constant notional demand consumes half of annual usable production. Minimum reserve and 90-day-buffer test are zero-loss references at monthly resolution; standing forage, cut fodder and hay quality are not distinguished.
water: Distance to mapped rivers/lakes only; no measured volume, permanence, salinity, wells or animal-specific watering itinerary.
institutions: Production is evaluated over all land independently of polity claims. Pilot claim labels describe source-map context only; no society's livelihood is assigned from biome.
